title: TX monthly seasonality — buy month-open, sell month-close
question: Under the the standard monthly seasonality contract, what does buying at each month's open and selling at that month's close show for TX (MXF continuous front-month), by calendar month and by week-in-month, across the full available weekly history?
hypothesis: This is a full-coverage seasonality reproduction (ported from the read-only legacy trading/tx/macro_analysis.py, verified numerically identical), not a new hypothesis test; it exists to give the owner a recurring, market-agnostic report shape they can rerun for any instrument.

findings.title: January and February are the strongest calendar months
findings.detail: 14 years each: January 71.4% win rate (+377 pts avg), February 64.3% (+396 pts avg) — both LONG bias.

findings.title: Not every LONG-biased month is strong evidence
findings.detail: n = number of years (14 at most). Treat calendar-month bias as descriptive seasonality context, not a standalone trading signal — sample size is inherently small for a once-a-year event.

findings.title: Month-start (week 1) has the highest week-in-month win rate
findings.detail: 58.6% across all 169 months, ahead of week 2 (53.9%) — consistent with the report's own headline question (buy month-open).
